name: map-guard-section-absence
title: Stop the map guard passing silently when the structure section is absent
description: The generated-map guard treats a docs/repomix-map.md with no # Directory Structure section as a pass, so a repomix output-format change would silently disable the check instead of failing loudly. Found by Copilot on rwbp-coordinator PR #225 during the 0.71.6 fleet rollout.
creator: sdelmas
